findings.title: Map target selection and target contour are absent
findings.reproduction: Import regionFixture(), select 2,0, Edit, start Transfer hex, physically click target hex 3,0. Native selector remains 1. E7 overlay contains only source cell 2,0 and zero map targets.
findings.expected: T01 requires equivalent map/list selection; UI-v1 requires distinct source and target contour/hover and current screen geometry hit resolution.
findings.actual: All map clicks return immediately while any region draft exists; only the list can choose a target.
findings.verification: Independent headless Chromium at width390 plus exact-source inspection.

findings.title: Transfer silently changes accepted candidate ordering
findings.reproduction: Import regionFixture(), capture candidateHexes, prepare actual App transfer2,0 from1 to2. Before subsequence is 3,-1;2,1;4,0;4,-1. After is 4,0;4,-1;3,-1;2,1. Sets match, arrays differ.
findings.expected: T01 explicitly preserves accepted entries/order when the geometric frontier is unchanged.
findings.actual: Preparation rebuilds the array by changed region traversal. New domain documentation replaces the approved preservation contract with recomputation.
findings.verification: Independent actual prepareRegionMapEdit diagnostic; candidate set equality and array inequality both checked.
findings.fix_risk: Preserve accepted E7 array and reconcile v7 import order deliberately. If persisted order is retained only for an exact valid frontier, check uniqueness separately from Set equality; current save validation only validates candidate coordinates. Retain prior normalization for malformed/mismatching/legacy data and verify empty world and sea exclusion.

findings.title: Preview omits required consequences
findings.reproduction: regionFixture has local mountains override at2,0. Height1 to2/open_hills preview gives generic preserved wording, without exception count. Source inspection shows preview lists regional sizes/biomes, POI count and Auto marks only; it never reports affected rivers or owner transitions. A separate real physical-edge diagnostic confirms edge121.244,-14|121.244,14 can change owner1 to2 while path/F1 remain fixed.
findings.expected: H01 requires local-exception count. D01/X01 requires affected rivers, owner transition counts and real POI-key consequences; T01 requires explicit inherited height change for the moved cell.
findings.actual: No river-owner plan, explicit POI key mapping, local-exception count, or explicit moved-cell inherited height before/after is displayed.
findings.verification: Independent Chromium preview text and source inspection; independent real geometry owner-remap diagnostic.

findings.title: Named target options omit stable IDs
findings.reproduction: Import an otherwise valid fixture with both region RU names set to the same retained name. Open transfer list. Options are identical names, with only current marker on source; named destinations never show ID. With multiple same-name destinations the list cannot distinguish them.
findings.expected: T01/UI-v1 requires exact name/ID and unambiguous duplicate-name selection; accessible names also identify region or coordinate.
findings.actual: ID is used only as fallback when a name is missing; height and transfer accessible names omit region identity/hex coordinate.
findings.verification: Independent Chromium imported retained duplicate names and inspected native option labels.

findings.title: An active draft with stale revision remains open without recovery message
findings.reproduction: Temporary diagnostic only: create valid transfer draft, decrease that active draft's captured revision by1, call actual finishRegionDraft with the same draft object. It returns false, draftStillOpen=true, previewError=null; accepted document remains equal.
findings.expected: X01 closes an active outdated draft and reports that the map changed and the value must be selected again. An old callback must still leave any newer draft alone.
findings.actual: Revision mismatch shares a silent return with busy/identity/IME guards, leaving an apparently valid preview that Done cannot accept.
findings.verification: Exact-source inspection plus temporary revision-stamp fault injection through existing App harness; not claimed as a natural external event.

Export notice is conditional only on waterDraft; E7 draft has no short accepted-document JSON/PNG notice required by X01. Existing developer browser evidence checks actual PNG exclusion, so this is a communication gap, not observed draft leakage.

test_usefulness.assessment: Useful coverage of transaction atomicity, POI identity, new-side versus legacy compatibility, directed river owners, ROAD07 ordinary-versus-emergency meaning, actual save/reload continuation, and native select Enter. Assertions mostly compare full saved documents and executable history, which is material.
gaps: Browser lifecycle treats ignored map click as sufficient safety but never requires target selection by map or target contour.
No candidate-array preservation assertion; deterministic reload equality alone accepts an unauthorized normalization.
No duplicate destination-name case, active stale-revision recovery expectation, or complete consequence-preview assertions.
Unit policy fixtures are synthetic; integration tests partly compensate with real App geometry, but finite fixtures do not prove all hydrological networks.

limitations: No source/diff/PNG/bundle/blob/tree/PR uploaded by reviewer; source sync remains blocked by automatic review.
Generated report PNG side effects already present were excluded from source identity; no repository reset or source edit.
Headless Chromium only; no physical touch device, AT, Safari, Firefox or WCAG AA audit.
No full score or game coverage assessment; scoped checks cannot establish all model thresholds.
No main change, merge, deploy, release approval or external messages/comments.
